Jane Addams, Democracy and Social Ethics.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/jane-addams/democracy-and-social-ethics

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Jane Addams, the author, died 1935 (Wikidata Q180989, P570 = 1935-06-21).

First publication of the text used: 1902 (SE colophon: 'Democracy and Social Ethics was published in 1902 by Jane Addams.'). The bibliography in the Wikipedia article on Jane Addams gives New York, The Macmillan Company, 1902.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1902, before 1931, so the US rule settles its origin too. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1997.
- Country of origin (United States): the first publication was by The Macmillan Company in New York in 1902, before 1931, so the US rule settles the origin, whatever the death year (1935).

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
